content.short_description: Wurth M10x50-A2-70 hex bolt, M10x1.5 thread, 50mm length, 304 stainless steel with A2-70 property class per ISO 3506-1.
content.long_description:
The Wurth M10x50-A2-70 is a hex head bolt manufactured from 304 stainless steel with an A2-70 property class rating, conforming to ISO 3506-1. The bolt features an external hex drive and a metric M10 thread with a 1.5 mm pitch, and measures 50 mm in overall length.

Material tensile strength is rated at 700 MPa, consistent with the A2-70 designation for stainless steel fasteners under ISO 3506-1. The finish is passivated, which is a chemical treatment applied to stainless steel to remove free iron from the surface and support the material's corrosion resistance characteristics.

This bolt is suited for general industrial fastening applications requiring an M10x1.5 thread and 50mm grip length in a corrosion-resistant stainless steel construction. Confirm mating nut, washer, and tapped hole thread specifications (M10x1.5) before installation.
